site.name: PDF Tool
site.description: Merge, split, compress and protect PDF files directly in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

home.headline: Every PDF tool you need — in your browser
home.subline: Merge, split, reorder, compress, watermark and protect PDFs. Everything runs locally on your device, so nothing is uploaded and nothing is stored.
home.privacyBadge: Files are processed on your device only

local.title: Runs locally
local.text: All processing happens in your browser using WebAssembly and JavaScript — no server round-trip.

noUpload.title: No upload, no storage
noUpload.text: Your documents are never transmitted, never cached and never stored on a server.

free.title: Free to use
free.text: No account, no page limit, no watermark forced on your output.

dropzone.privacy: Files stay on your device — nothing is uploaded.

result.heading: {count, plural, one {Your file is ready} other {Your # files are ready}}

errors.invalidPdf: This file could not be read as a PDF. It may be damaged or not a PDF at all.
errors.encrypted: This PDF is password protected. Remove the password first using the Protect tool.
errors.notEncrypted: This PDF is not password protected.
errors.emptySelection: Nothing selected. Choose at least one file or page.
errors.invalidRange: The page range could not be understood. Use a format like "1-3, 5, 8-".
errors.unsupportedCharacters: The text contains characters the built-in font cannot render. Use Latin characters only.
errors.renderFailed: The pages could not be rendered. The document may be damaged.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while processing this file.
errors.unsupportedImage: This image format is not supported. Use PNG or JPEG.
errors.fontUnavailable: The font file could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.noTextLayer: This page contains no text layer.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine several PDF files into a single document, in any order you like.
merge.orderHeading: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} selected
merge.fileOrderHint: Drag the rows or use the arrow buttons to change the file order. Newly added files are appended to the page grid below.
merge.pagesHeading: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} in the result
merge.pageOrderHint: Drag any page to move it — pages can be reordered across files, rotated or removed individually. The coloured chip shows which file a page came from.
merge.singleFileNote: With one file this reorders and rotates its pages. Add more files to combine them.

split.title: Split PDF
split.description: Break one document into several files — by page range, in fixed chunks, or one file per page.
split.rangesHint: Document has {pages} pages. Each comma-separated part becomes its own file, e.g. "1-3, 4, 8-".
split.singleHint: This produces {count} separate files, one per page.
split.visualHint: Click the scissors between two pages to add or remove a split point. The colour bands show which file each page ends up in.

organize.title: Organize pages
organize.description: Delete, reorder, rotate and extract pages with a visual preview of the whole document.
organize.gridHint: Drag pages to reorder, or use the arrow buttons. Tick pages to extract them into a separate file.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Reduce file size — either losslessly, or by re-rendering pages at a lower image quality.
compress.rasterWarning: This mode converts every page into an image. File size drops a lot, but the result no longer contains selectable or searchable text.
compress.losslessNote: Rewrites the file with object and cross-reference streams. Text and images stay untouched, so savings depend on how the original was written — often 5-20%.
compress.qualityHint: Lower quality means a smaller file and more visible JPEG artefacts.
compress.dpiHint: 150 dpi is fine for screen reading, 300 dpi for printing.
compress.noSavings: No size reduction achieved ({before} → {after}). Try the strong mode or a lower quality setting.

watermark.title: Add watermark
watermark.description: Stamp text across your pages, with adjustable size, colour, transparency and layout.

page-numbers.title: Add page numbers
page-numbers.description: Place page numbers anywhere on the page, with control over format, size and starting number.

edit.short: Add text, marker, images — like an office tool
edit.title: Edit PDF
edit.description: Add and format text, highlight passages, place images, and replace text the document already contains.
edit.elementCount: {count, plural, =0 {No elements yet} one {# element} other {# elements}}
edit.markerHint: Drag across the page to highlight.
edit.recognized: Found {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}. Click one to replace it — it gets covered and reopened as an editable box.
edit.noTextLayer: No text layer found on this page. The page is probably a scan; its text is pixels, not characters. Recognising scanned text (OCR) is not part of this version.
edit.coverWarning: The background behind that line is not one flat colour, so covering it may leave a visible patch. Check the result before exporting.
edit.unsupportedInFont: A text box contains characters the chosen font cannot render. Switch that box to Noto Sans, which also covers Greek and Cyrillic.
edit.flattenNote: Elements are drawn into the page content, not added as annotations — they cannot be moved again after export. Replacing text works by covering the original and redrawing it, so the new text uses the chosen font rather than the document’s original one.
edit.toolbarHint: Pick a tool, then click or drag on the page. Double-click a text box to edit it, drag to move, arrow keys to nudge, Delete to remove. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies elements; Ctrl+V also pastes images from the clipboard.

sign.short: Draw a signature and place it
sign.title: Sign PDF
sign.description: Draw, type or upload your signature, then place it anywhere on the document.
sign.placeHint: Click the page to place the signature. Drag it to move, use the corner handle to resize, arrow keys to nudge.
sign.placedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Not placed yet} one {# placement} other {# placements}}
sign.legalNote: This places a visual signature. It is not a cryptographic or qualified electronic signature under eIDAS.

protect.title: Password protect
protect.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password and permission flags — or remove an existing password.
protect.alreadyEncrypted: This PDF is already password protected. Switch to "Remove password" first.
protect.ownerPasswordHint: Grants full access and bypasses the permissions below. Defaults to the password above.
protect.permissionsHint: Permission flags are part of the PDF standard, but enforcement depends on the reader. They are not a substitute for the password itself.
protect.currentPasswordHint: The password needed to open the document today.

footer.privacyClaim: All processing happens in your browser. No uploads.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How this website handles your data.

0.heading: Your PDF files
0.body: PDF files you open with this tool are processed entirely inside your browser. They are not uploaded, not transmitted to any server, not cached and not stored. When you close or reload the page, they are gone from memory. No copy exists anywhere else.

1.heading: Language preference
1.body: Your language is detected from the Accept-Language header your browser sends. If you change the language manually, that choice is stored in a NEXT_LOCALE cookie so the site remembers it on your next visit. This cookie contains nothing but the language code.
